Actual read scope
• All 12 complete EN/RU primary pairs: あの, など, ストーブ, スリッパ, ボタン, ポスト, マッチ, 伯母さん, 字引, 生徒, 番号, 難しい. All 429 EN/590 RU lines, including metadata, examples, readings, forms and source notes; four consecutive three-pair chunks.
• All 25 complete contextual pairs in ru-047-final-evidence-bindings-001.json: 靴, 辞書, 学生, 留学生, 大変, 苦しい, 辛い, うるさい, 箱, 仕事, 親戚, その, この, あれ, あんな, ええ, さあ, 重い, 嫌, 汚い, 暗い, これ, それ, 花, いい. Successful half-open pair ranges: 0:3, 3:6, 6:9, 9:12, 12:15, 15:18, 18:21, 21:24, 24:25.
• All 87 COMPLETE serialized official JMdict objects, including unrelated exact-form/citation matches, in ten-object chunks 0:80 and final 80:87. Each RETURNED047 range completed. Separate entries/readings and sense restrictions were retained, not merged into queried lemmas.
• All 872 actual captions/readings/types/JLPT/tags/kanji/exclusions/distractors: 100-row chunks 0:800, then 800:872. Every displayed metadata projection and all 872 working-raw hashes matched actual RU files. The 860 baseline-word raw hashes also matched intake; their 860 complete lesson bodies were NOT all reviewed.
• Complete current RU general instructions (390 actual lines), scoped content-structure instructions (253), and localized C1/C2/C3 reviewer contracts (43/54/44). Complete methodology (138) and format reference (107); FULL-TRANSLATION-PLAN 1–37,316–419,494–515; IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN 1–80,1420–1451,1584–1631. Frozen confusable-words ALL 1–356 and content-format EXACT 95–179. Historical milestones were not assigned semantic rereview.
• Intake scope/navigation/bindings, all substantive source-adjudication decisions and 17 rationales, complete authoring-freeze and authoring records. The durable 25-pair/87-object inventories matched final bindings. Intake and pre-writing semantic freeze remain 95285ab9f3075c276269e71e4a15620552060f30 and cd7ed8d4caaee4aa2b7b70f21891d041e2305e34.
• Actual Kotobank named text fetched: Shogakukan 大辞泉 生徒 senses1–2 and 精選版; modern がくせい 大辞泉 and complete 日本大百科全書 definition signed 金子忠史. Historical がくしょう material was not treated as modern がくせい evidence. URLs: https://kotobank.jp/word/%E7%94%9F%E5%BE%92-545959 and https://kotobank.jp/word/%E5%AD%A6%E7%94%9F-460366 .

Independent conclusions
C1 Japanese correctness: CLEAN for the 12 new lessons within this review. Examples, readings, adjective/する forms, particle roles, separate homographs and qualified school terminology are preserved correctly. No actionable Japanese/prose-translation defect established.
C2 consistency/scope/dependencies/quiz suitability: NEEDS FIX, R047-1 below. Adopted lesson scope and navigation are otherwise accounted for: five retained source wrappers, nine unavailable optional wrappers unwrapped with their Japanese information/readings preserved; all 17 proposed declarations exist. No new provider closure is invented. Broader whole-pool semantic uniqueness and ordinary modern necessity/frequency remain UNVERIFIED, not CLEAN.
C3 Russian comprehensibility: CLEAN for all 12 new lessons. Russian explanations stand alone; stove/cooktop, identifying-number/count and difficulty/material-hardness adaptations preserve the Japanese distinctions. Quoted borrowing forms or the source-list word match do not require English comprehension.

Finding
R047-1 — Moderate; C2; unresolved; high confidence. words\あの.md:9,36–37; words\あれ.md:4,9,16,27; words\それ.md:4–9. Under the bare-written-question boundary, あの also has the ordinary distal prenominal homograph (JMdict1000420:1), not just hesitation1000430. Actual あれ caption «вон то» is a defensible distal gloss, also usable before a Russian neuter noun; actual それ caption «то; это» contains the unqualified distal «то». Compare their separate demonstrative entries1000580:1 and1006970:1 and the already-read あの本/あの店 explanations. Neither caption encodes a restriction that makes it unambiguously wrong for that homograph. Their titles differ from the new hesitation title, so exact-title dedup does not protect these pairs. The declared あの–その protection does not apply transitively.
Minimal correction: add direct あの–あれ and あの–それ exclusions, declared once on あの if desired; no reciprocal baseline edits are required. These are two actual-caption judgments, not an automatic demonstrative clique. No extension to この/これ/あんな follows. No runtime quiz execution is claimed.

All 17 proposed pair dispositions
Q means individually supported as a QUALIFIED conservative lexical/context guard; retention is defensible within that boundary, not proof of ordinary necessity or candidate acceptance.
1 Q あの–その: hesitation1000430:1/1006830:3, plus separate prenominal1000420:1 versus actual «тот (перед существительным)».
2 Q あの–ええ: hesitation1001140:2, usually えー; “usually” is not a categorical ban on ええ. Not affirmative=yes equivalence.
3 Q あの–さあ: uncertainty/hesitation1005110:3 and actual «ну; давайте»; not encouragement generally.
4 Q スリッパ–靴: actual «тапочки» versus generic «обувь»,1073900:1/1246700:1. Caption safeguard, not identity of all footwear.
5 Q ボタン–花: independent peony1182880:1 explicitly permits kana-only ボタン; «цветок» can describe that referent. Not Portuguese button=flower; boar meat is restricted to ぼたん.
6 Q ポスト–箱: actual «почтовый ящик» versus «коробка; ящик; футляр»,1125150:1/1585650:1; physical-container precaution only.
7 Q ポスト–仕事: position1125150:2 versus actual «работа» in its employment reading,1304970:1 and the complete RU仕事 body. Not every task=position.
8 Q マッチ–いい: actual «подходит» fits matching/going well with,2784220:2, including the complete colour/room example. Preserve マッチする; not all good=matching.
9 Q 生徒–学生: broad learner sense1379380:1/1206900:1 and actual named Shogakukan evidence; institutional preferences are not absolute age boundaries.
10 Q 生徒–留学生: new «учащийся» directly fits the overseas learner in1552750:1 and the actual complete 留学生 body; independently justified, not via学生.
11 Q 難しい–大変: direct «трудный» overlap,1460850:1/1415000:3–4; no intensifier equivalence.
12 Q 難しい–苦しい: difficult circumstances1244320:1–2; preserve suffering/hardship rather than equating every puzzle with pain.
13 Q 難しい–辛い: separate standalone つらい1365860:1–2, also1365850:4; not spice, and not unsupported bare づらい suffix reasoning.
14 Q 難しい–重い: serious disease/problem1460850:1 and severity1335750:4–5; actual «тяжёлый», not physical weight generally.
15 Q 難しい–うるさい: difficult/fussy person context1460850:1,3/1481920:2–3; not noise=complexity.
16 Q 難しい–汚い: explicitly ARCHAIC dirty1460850:5 versus actual «грязный»1178940:1. Lexical precaution only, not a taught modern N5 use.
17 Q 難しい–嫌: explicitly ARCHAIC unpleasant1460850:6 versus actual «неприятный»1587610:2; same strict limitation.
All guards protect both directions when declared once.

Exact-caption dedup
字引 and 辞書 are distinct raw RU files (working SHA256 prefixes abeaead1e5648c15 / a3ec30233c5400a7), both actually titled «словарь». Full entries1315140:1/1318970:1 independently confirm the dictionary sense. The frozen exact-title contract already separates them; no additional guard is required. This is not title-equality-only semantic approval.

Limits and gates
Baseline bodies outside the 25 contextual pairs were not semantically reread. Full metadata screening and 87 complete XML reads do not certify every secondary sense of 872 words. No mandatory 難しい–暗い edge was established from English gloomy/dark: actual «тёмный; слабо освещённый» is not automatically «мрачный». Shared third glosses, categories and transitive paths do not establish further guards.
Protected excluded docs\translation-drafts\033-nature-outdoor-activity\words\空.md remains unassigned/unread/unaccepted, C2 UNVERIFIED; its declared dffd2334… hash is not a fresh review. It is not a third media draft.
No repository edits, build/tests, publisher execution, Git mutation, delegation or agent messages. The first oversized instruction output was tool-spilled and not counted; complete bounded rereads replaced it. Ordinary dirty EN and shared Android were not accessed. Author mechanical checks are not independent semantic evidence. No media/audio/package, device/IME/playback, release or RU-default approval is inherited or granted. Checkpoint authority remains null; the finite full-translation task remains incomplete.
